_comment: Single source of truth for what the uptime probes check.
Read by scripts/uptime_probe.py, which is run by BOTH the GitHub Actions
cron and the Railway cron service. Previously each tool kept its own
hardcoded list, which is how 'webapp' silently went unmonitored after it
was deployed as its own service. Add a service here and every probe picks
Services with no public URL (python-worker, suwappu-relayer) cannot be
probed over HTTP at all — they are covered by the Railway deploy webhook
and by `python3 scripts/status.py`, which reads the control plane.
